rows.en: Touya: "They just keep crawling out, one after another..."
Ai: "Touya. I'm doing things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but I'll be acting on my own
this time."
Clovis: "I'm going solo. I'm leaving things over there to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I can't trust you with my life yet.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act on my own."
Fain: "The burning spirit of justice
has yet to dwell within you! I can't follow someone like that!
So I'll follow my own justice! That is all!"
Celica: "Sorry to keep you waiting!"
Touya: "Celica?! What's with that machine and its pom-poms?"
Celica: "I don't know what you mean by 'pom-poms,'
but this one's name is Selphin.
It's the first Spirit Mech prototype you've heard about."
Touya: "Oh, the machine you secretly built Rayblade's technology into,
turning everyone into your accomplices."
Celica: "You make it sound so bad! Well, yes, that's true.
But once you hear what this little one's capable of,
you won't be saying that."
Touya: "Capable of what?"
Celica: "Believe it or not,
it's got a 'complementary repair system'
built right in!
In plain terms, it's a device that repairs a Spirit Mech's armor.
If you get damaged, leave it to me."
Touya: "I don't really get it, but using that device
will let you repair damage, right?
Then I'll leave the repairs to you."
Celica: "Understood. But I'm counting on you for orders."
Ai: "That's... Orbest! Don't tell me it's Kasumi?!"
Touya: "What?!"
Kasumi: "I'm sorry! But... I don't want to be a burden,
either. Touya-chan and the others are in danger,
and I can't just do nothing..."
Ai: "You mean 'Touya,' without 'and the others,' don't you?"
Kasumi: "..."
Ymir: "Anyway, you've already launched,
so there's no helping it. Fortunately, you seem to be near the nest...
Kasumi, do you know how to use the Spread Missile?"
Kasumi: "Y-Yes! Should I fire over there?"
Ymir: "Yes, please."
Kasumi: "Understood!
Um, release the safety and check the target...!!"
Kasumi: "What's that...?"
Kasumi: "No..."
Kasumi: "N..."
Kasumi: "N-Noooooo!!!!"
Kasumi: "Aaaaaah... Wait, huh?"
Clovis: "Scary..."
Xiujian: "A fine example of how the quiet ones can react
when they finally lose their restraint."
Fain: "I didn't see it. I didn't see anything!"
Arthur: "It seems we'd better not make her angry."
Touya: "Yeah. I know that firsthand."
Touya: "Something big just came out..."
Clovis: "Be careful. It's in a different class from the others."
Fain: "Is that the Queen?
Then... the star of the show has arrived."
Yamato: "Hey, don't the Baluamy seem more lively, too?"
Touya: "...Yeah, we might need to be careful.
We have to do something about them, anyway.
...Let's go!"
Yamato: "Touya!"
Touya: "Yeah. We won't get anywhere without hitting the source..."
Ymir: "Everyone! We've found a suspicious place up ahead."
Touya: "It certainly looks the part.
Maybe that's where this Queen thing is.
All right, let's do something about it!"
Touya: "There are still more of them?!"
Yamato: "We're in danger if this keeps up..."
Touya: "What can we do...?"
Touya: "Damn... At this rate..."
Clovis: "Touya! Remember how it felt back then!"
Touya: "Back then..."
Clovis: "That's right. Calm your mind and concentrate!
Don't think with your head. Feel it with your heart!"
Touya: "My heart..."
Touya: "An image..."
Touya: "Here I gooooo!"
Yamato: "A-Amazing... You're amazing, Touya!"
Touya: "Heh heh heh... All right! Let's do this in one go!"

review_batches.context: Examined full84-row member and neighboring Kasumi rescue/aftermath. Repeated independent-order variants, Celica introduces Selphin repair ability, Kasumi launches Orbest and reacts fearfully, Queen/nest battle and power breakthrough.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Selphin first prototype/Rayblade-tech accomplice accusation as dialogue. Complementary repair system repairs mech armor, not biological injury; Celica asks Touya command, correct direction. Orbest/Kasumi identity questioned then confirmed by reply. Spread Missile is fictional weapon tutorial with only printed safety/target phrase, no new procedure. Queen identification/location only tentative, Baluamy livelier no invented command biology. Alternatives and repeated heart/image prompts distinct.
